accroche.texte: 8 agent skills for Blender scenes, browser graphics and image rendering

explication.texte: Lets any LLM model, build and change a Blender scene through MCP; a community plugin, not by the Blender Foundation.
passages: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM of your choice. Not affiliated with the official Blender Foundation.
Prompt-assisted 3D modeling, scene creation, and manipulation — driven by AI.
Prompt-assisted 3D modeling, scene creation, and manipulation — driven by AI.

explication.texte: A pack of 94 Blender skills that takes an asset from blockout to engine export through Blender MCP.
passages: 94 specialist Blender skills for Cursor, Claude Code, Kiro & Codex -> MCP-powered production pipeline from blockout to engine export.
MCP-powered production pipeline from blockout to engine export.

explication.texte: Generates a target image first, then a critic compares each Blender render to it until the scene matches.
passages: AI "dreams" up a high-quality target screenshot using image generation
A separate AI critic compares the live screenshot to the target and provides feedback
Agent skill for impressive 3D visuals using Blender + image gen + subagent critic

explication.texte: Nine skills and a Vite scaffold so your agent ships a playable Three.js browser game with gameplay, UI and checks.
passages: Agent skills for building playable, polished Three.js browser games with gameplay, AAA-style graphics, UI, QA, and optional AI-generated 3D, image, and audio assets.
One shared pack of nine skills serves Codex and Claude Code.
Agent skills for building playable, polished Three.js browser games

explication.texte: Teaches your agent WebGPU in Three.js, including shaders written in TSL; also ships as Cursor rules.
passages: An Agent Skill for developing WebGPU-enabled Three.js applications using TSL (Three.js Shading Language).
Writing shaders using TSL (Three.js Shading Language)
Writing shaders using TSL (Three.js Shading Language)

explication.texte: Describe a world and get an explorable Three.js or Blender scene, built from a large catalog of tested recipes.
passages: Agent skill for creative 3D visualization: turn an idea into a Three.js/Blender scene worth exploring.
223 recipes, 440 knowledge records, 22 proved kits, 37 runnable studies.
turn an idea into a Three.js/Blender scene worth exploring.

explication.texte: Drive a local ComfyUI in plain language: it wires the graph, frees VRAM and renders images, video or audio.
passages: The Agent panel driving ComfyUI end to end. It reads what is installed locally,
wires the graph, frees VRAM, and runs the render.
MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio

explication.texte: Explains a technical idea as an isometric machine with many small parts, drawn in SVG with optional WebGL.
passages: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems.
Crafted, interactive isometric figures with many small precise parts, in SVG, WebGL and 3D.
Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
